# Submission Checklist

## Hard Gates
- [ ] Agent was built via ClawUp.
- [ ] Agent works through Telegram.
- [ ] Agent is registered on GOAT Network Mainnet with ERC-8004.
- [ ] Agent appears on `https://8004scan.io/agents?chain=2345`.
- [ ] Submission form is submitted before 5:45 PM.

## Project Details
- [ ] Agent name recorded.
- [ ] Team name recorded.
- [ ] Public demo link or instructions recorded.
- [ ] ERC-8004 agent ID recorded.
- [ ] Mainnet transaction hash recorded.
- [ ] x402 evidence recorded if used.

## Demo Readiness
- [ ] Agent can answer what it does.
- [ ] Agent explains how to use it.
- [ ] Core workflow works live.
- [ ] High-risk action requires confirmation.
- [ ] x402 payment path works if used.
- [ ] 2-minute script rehearsed.
